We got three templates. The first one (reaction_id 2895) seems to be nitro to amine reduction: retro_smarts_template shows product side with amine and reactant side with nitro. The mapped_rxn is provided. We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is the reaction_id? Or maybe template_id is the ID field in the template entry. The description says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". In search results, each entry has 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. The template_id likely corresponds to reaction_id. So we should return template_id = 2895 and mapped_rxn = the mapped_rxn string from that entry.

Let's extract mapped_rxn for reaction_id 2895. It's a long string: 

' O=[N+:15]([O-])[c:14]1[cH:13][c:12]([N:11]2[CH2:10][CH2:9][N:8]([C:6]([O:5][C:2]([CH3:1])([CH3:3])[CH3:4])=[O:7])[CH2:27][CH2:26]2)[c:18]2[c:17]([cH:16]1)[CH2:25][CH2:24][C:20]1([O:19]2)[CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]1>>[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])[CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1'

But need to ensure exact string from result. Let's copy exactly.

The mapped_rxn string in result: 

'O=[N+:15]([O-])[c:14]1[cH:13][c:12]([N:11]2[CH2:10][CH2:9][N:8]([C:6]([O:5][C:2]([CH3:1])([CH3:3])[CH3:4])=[O:7])[CH2:27][CH2:26]2)[c:18]2[c:17]([cH:16]1)[CH2:25][CH2:24][C:20]1([O:19]2)[CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]1>>[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])[CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1'

Wait there is an extra parenthesis after [CH3:4])? Let's verify: The string appears to have mismatched parentheses. But we will output as given.

Thus final answer JSON: {'mapped_rxn': 'O=[N+:15]([O-])[c:14]1[cH:13][c:12]([N:11]2[CH2:10][CH2:9][N:8]([C:6]([O:5][C:2]([CH3:1])([CH3:3])[CH3:4])=[O:7])[CH2:27][CH2:26]2)[c:18]2[c:17]([cH:16]1)[CH2:25][CH2:24][C:20]1([O:19]2)[CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]1>>[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])[CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1', 'template_id': 2895}

Check parentheses: there is an extra ) after [CH3:4]) before [O:5]. Might be a typo in data but we keep as is.
